name: CVB Financial Corp.
summary: CVB Financial Corp. operates as bank holding company for Citizens Business Bank, National Association, a chartered bank that provides banking and financial services to small to mid-sized businesses and individuals. The company offers checking, savings, money market, and certificates of time deposit products for business and personal accounts, municipalities and districts, and specialized deposit products for title and escrow; and serves as a federal tax depository for business customers.
